messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Esperanto, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Esperanto line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
Li ĉasos ŝin tra ĉiu urbo, Ĝis kiam li revenigos ŝin al la infero, Tie de kie enviado unue sendis ŝin.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑by‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (Esperanto → English) | Status | |-------------|-----------------------|----------------------|------------------------------------------|--------| | Questi | male agent, subject | Li | **He** | OK | | la | accusative clitic, “her” | ŝin | **her** | OK | | caccerà | future of “hunt” | ĉasos | **will hunt** | OK | | per | preposition “through” | tra | **through** | OK | | ogne | determiner “every” | ĉiu | **every** | OK | | villa | noun “town” | urbo | **town** | OK | | fin | temporal subordinator “until” | Ĝis | **until** | OK | | che | temporal subordinator “when” | kiam | **when** | OK | | l'avrà | future auxiliary “will have” (marks future perfect) | li | **he** (subject of the following verb) | OK | | rimessa | “set back / return” (future perfect) | revenigos | **will set back** | OK | | ne | preposition “in / to” (archaic “ne lo ’nferno”) | al | **to** | OK | | lo | masculine definite article “the” (redundant in Esperanto) | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | ’nferno | noun “hell” | infero | **hell** | OK | | là | adverb of place “there” | Tie | **there** | OK | | onde | relative adverb “whence” | de kie | **whence** | OK | | ’nvidia | personified “envy” (cause) | enviado | **messenger / envoy** | **WRONG** (should be *invido* or *invideco*) | | prima | temporal adverb “first” | unue | **first** | OK | | dipartilla | future “will send forth” (with clitic “‑la”) | sendis | **sent** | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention
- **WRONG**: *’nvidia* → **enviado**. The Esperanto word *enviado* means “messenger”, not “envy”. The correct translation should be **invido** (noun) or **invideco** (abstract noun). - **UNNECESSARY**: *lo* (definite article) – Esperanto does not use articles, so the element is naturally omitted. - No source words are **MISSING**; every source token has a corresponding target element (even if the target element is a grammatical placeholder). - No **GRAMMAR** errors were detected in the Esperanto sentences (agreement, case, word order are all acceptable).

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Esperanto script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Esperanto text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 1: - Original: Li ĉasos ŝin tra ĉiu urbo, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 2: - Original: Ĝis kiam li revenigos ŝin al la infero, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 3: - Original: Tie de kie enviado unue sendis ŝin. - Issue: WRONG – “enviado” does not mean “envy”. - Corrected: Tie de kie **invido** unue sendis ŝin.
``` Li ĉasos ŝin tra ĉiu urbo, Ĝis kiam li revenigos ŝin al la infero, Tie de kie invido unue sendis ŝin. ```
